interface.longDescription: Bruce keeps software delivery proportional in the current Codex task, with evidence-driven standard/full profiles, four internal Functional Agent contracts, explicit Model Profile override/fallback resolution, one conditional Design Gate, one Completion Gate, verifiable Given/When/Then scenarios, layered real-use validation, bounded repair loops, and Goal-independent execution, recovery, and delegation. Native Goal is outside the Bruce workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use Bruce to implement this change with proportional planning and verification.
